section_1_presentation_and_advisory.name: Strategic Delivery & Value Articulation
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.focus: Can they connect technical architecture to business value? Can they clearly articulate why they built this solution and how it handles commercial reality?
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.criteria: Delivers a compelling, narrative-driven walkthrough of the user experience framed around customer personas and operational impact. Explicitly justifies why the architecture directly solves the root business problem (avoiding a 'science project') and presents a viable Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) model that demonstrates fiscal responsibility.

section_1_presentation_and_advisory.name: Objection Handling & Technical Defense
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.focus: How do they react to executive pushback, and can they programmatically defend their implementation choices?
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.criteria: Remains entirely calm, collected, and collaborative under pressure when facing stakeholder resistance. Confidently defends engineering decisions and structural design choices during the Q&A matrix using data-backed logic, while cleanly evaluating and addressing technical trade-offs (e.g., cost vs. latency, model tiering).

section_1_presentation_and_advisory.name: Presentation Skills & Time Management
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.focus: How effectively do they manage time, pacing, and the overall flow of the meeting?
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.criteria: Paces the presentation to finish on time. Tactfully steers the panel away from rabbit holes, offering to take tangential topics offline without being dismissive. Demonstrates intellectual honesty by confidently admitting 'I don't know, but I will get back to you' rather than fabricating answers.

section_1_presentation_and_advisory.name: AI Driven Development Discussion
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.focus: How effectively do they demonstrate the use of GenAI tools and harness concepts to accelerate their own development lifecycle and code quality?
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.criteria: Articulates how their harness was set up before coding. Demonstrates understanding of establishing key guidance that enables both 'in the loop' (quick feature fix that adheres to spec) and 'outside the loop' (goal driven - task is taken and executed in a loop through lint, test, etc. until goal is passed) development. Incorporates mistakes by the agent/harness back into agent instructions.

section_1_presentation_and_advisory.name: Futures / Roadmap (GCP Value)
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.focus: Can they communicate what the next phase of development would look like while driving home the value of Google Cloud?
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.criteria: Articulates a clear, progressive roadmap for future development phases, addressing key elements like production-grade scalability, performance optimization, and features of the solution that the customer would want in production. Effectively demonstrates the strategic value of Google Cloud integration, explaining how native GCP services enhance stability, security, and long-term business value.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Agentic & Multi-Agent Systems
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Agent orchestration patterns, tool/function calling, planning and reasoning loops, memory and state management, multi-agent coordination, cognitive architectures, and integrating agents with legacy/external APIs.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Production-grade agent implementation using Google ADK with structured tool-calling, planning loops, session memory, state management, and error handling within enterprise latency thresholds.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Retrieval & Data Engineering for AI
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: RAG architecture patterns, embedding models and vector databases, chunking and indexing strategies, hybrid search, grounding and citation, data pipelines for AI, parsing complex document formats (PDF/HTML tables), and citation/grounding.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Reliable grounding and citation mechanisms mitigating hallucinations. Structured catalog integration with 100% verified, verifiable citations mapped to database primary keys.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Model Selection, Tuning & Optimization
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Model assessment and selection (quality, latency, cost, context), tuning, quantization, distillation, prompt engineering, structured output enforcement (JSON mode), and inference optimization.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Low-temperature determinism, token budgeting, structured JSON outputs enforced via schemas, and cost-effective model routing balancing latency and quality.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: LLM Ops and Evaluation
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Evaluation methodology for generative AI, quality metrics (faithfulness, relevance, coherence), eval dataset design, human vs. automated evaluation, regression detection, Observability (tracing/logging).
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Systematic evaluation flywheel with multi-metric benchmarking (faithfulness, data accuracy, latency) beyond simple LLM-as-a-judge, regression detection, and automated gates.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Domain-Applied AI/ML Expertise
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Translation of vertical-specific business KPIs into AI/ML objectives and architectures. Domain-specific feature engineering, data handling, and regulatory compliance.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Translation of vertical-specific business KPIs into AI/ML objectives and architectures. Domain feature engineering, data handling, and enterprise compliance.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Problem Definition
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Identifying and articulating the business problem, translating ambiguity into a technical opportunity, documenting what success unlocks for the customer.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Identifies, articulates business problems clearly; translates ambiguity into actionable technical opportunity. Documents customer success unlocks, justifying architecture as direct solution to root business problem.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Technical Scope & Constraints
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Defining technical scope, identifying constraints and assumptions, documenting system boundaries and the architectural approach prior to build.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Defines technical scope precisely; identifies critical constraints and assumptions. Documents system boundaries and architectural approach prior to build phase.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Stakeholder Alignment & Success Criteria
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Evidence of stakeholder alignment, defined success criteria and acceptance criteria, phased delivery plan or architectural roadmap.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Demonstrates robust stakeholder alignment; defines clear success and acceptance criteria. Comprehensive phased delivery plan synchronized with business expectations.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: System Design Artifacts
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, sequence diagrams.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Produces comprehensive architecture, data flow, and sequence diagrams clearly mapping system components, interaction patterns, and data lifecycles.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Decision Records
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: ADRs, documenting trade-offs, alternatives considered, rationale.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Maintains comprehensive Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) documenting critical trade-offs, alternatives considered, and logical rationale.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: API Documentation
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: OpenAPI specs, integration guides, SDK documentation.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Delivers precise OpenAPI specifications, detailed integration guides, and clear contracts facilitating developer adoption and predictable interactions.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Operational Documentation
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Deployment guides, runbooks, onboarding docs, troubleshooting guides.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Produces actionable deployment guides, runbooks, onboarding documentation, troubleshooting guides, and operational agent skills.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Authentication & Authorization
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Service accounts, IAM, API key scoping, OAuth/OIDC, Least Privilege.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Implements robust authentication/authorization via dedicated service accounts, scoped credentials, and strict Principle of Least Privilege across all IAM configurations.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Infrastructure & Network Security
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: VPC design, network segmentation, private endpoints, zero-trust architecture, service perimeters, firewall policies.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Designs secure VPCs with network segmentation, private endpoints, and zero-trust principles. Configures service perimeters (VPC-SC) and firewall policies protecting enterprise assets.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Data Protection & Privacy
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Encryption at rest/transit, PII handling, data classification, DLP, Secrets management.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Ensures encryption at rest and transit, manages PII handling and data classification, and utilizes secure secrets management preventing credential exposure.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: AI-Specific Security
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Prompt injection mitigation, output filtering, guardrails, model access controls, content safety.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Implements dedicated prompt injection mitigation (adversarial sanitization, tag delimiter encapsulation, system prompt immutability), output filtering/guardrails, model access controls, and content safety layers protecting against adversarial use.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Compliance & Governance
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Audit logging, data residency, regulatory requirements, policy enforcement.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Configures audit logging (Cloud Audit Logs) and data residency aligning with regulatory requirements. Enforces enterprise policy across all deployments.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Availability Design
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Redundancy, failover, health checks, SLO/SLA definition, distributed systems patterns.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Implements redundancy, failover, and automated health checks aligning with explicit SLO/SLA definitions. Utilizes distributed patterns ensuring high availability.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Observability
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, AI-specific monitoring.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Configures structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry / Cloud Trace). Monitors AI-specific KPIs (latency, token usage, quality) ensuring runtime visibility.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Failure & Recovery Testing
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Failure injection, red teaming, disaster recovery validation, backup/restore testing.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Executes failure injection, red teaming, and resilience testing under degraded conditions (timeouts, database disconnection, empty catalog, malformed queries) verifying recovery protocols.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Graceful Degradation
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Fallback strategies, circuit breakers, retry policies, timeout handling.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Implements fallback strategies, retry policies with backoff, circuit breakers, and timeout handling ensuring system stability during partial failures or high load without crashing.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Scalability & Elasticity
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Horizontal and vertical scaling strategies, autoscaling policies, load balancing.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Designs horizontal/vertical scaling strategies with autoscaling policies and load balancing, optimizing API throughput and scaling dynamically for load.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Resource Efficiency
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Compute/GPU right-sizing, autoscaling strategies, spot/preemptible usage.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Right-sizes compute resources; utilizes lightweight base images and efficient container runtimes to minimize cold-start latency and eliminate resource waste.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: AI Cost Management
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Model selection trade-offs, response caching, batching, memory and embeddings, token optimization.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Evaluates model selection trade-offs, manages token budgeting and query filtering to minimize database bytes scanned, and models infrastructure/inference costs.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: CI/CD & Deployment
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Pipeline design, deployment strategies, rollback automation.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Designs automated CI/CD pipelines with linting, testing coverage gates, automated container builds, artifact registry deployment, and rollback automation.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Infrastructure as Code
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Terraform/Pulumi, Cloud Build, reproducible environments, environment parity.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Utilizes modular, declarative Terraform/IaC for reproducible environments, ensuring strict environment parity without manual cloud configuration.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: AI Lifecycle Management
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Model and agent versioning, A/B testing, configurations, experiment tracking.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Manages model/agent versioning, evaluation dataset versioning, experiment tracking, and operational tooling for regression detection across iterations.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Testing & Quality Engineering
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Unit, integration, e2e testing, load and performance testing.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Executes comprehensive unit, integration, and e2e testing with automated coverage enforcement (>= 80%) and verified pass rates.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Modularity & Abstraction
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Loose coupling, interface contracts, model swappability, dependency injection.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Enforces loose coupling and interface contracts facilitating model swappability and modular code structure with clear architectural boundaries.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Configuration Management
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Environment separation, feature flags, externalized config.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Separates environment configurations using externalized settings (env files, secrets, parameters) enabling dynamic system adjustments without code changes.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: API Design & Versioning
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Backward compatibility, contract-first design, schema evolution.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Implements contract-first design with backward compatibility and structured schemas supporting graceful evolution across client releases.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: Extensibility
section_2_engineering_excellence.focus: Plugin patterns, event-driven architecture, webhook/callback support.
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Utilizes modular plugin patterns, extensible agent skills, or event-driven architecture enabling capability extensions with minimal core disruption.
